name: Ano Hi, Ano Toki, Shinenakattara Ore ga,
original_name: あの日、あの時、死ねなかった俺が、
source:
I'm dreaming. Something is chasing me.
I don't know what it is, but I know that it's something dangerous.

In my dreams, I'm always a boy.
With my short arms and legs, I have to run away.
What's more, I have to watch my best friend die over and over.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ273894.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我在做梦。有什么东西正在追我。
我不知道那是什么，却知道它很危险。

在梦里，我总还是个小男孩。
我必须拖着短小的手脚，不断逃跑。
更可怕的是，我还得一次又一次，看着最好的朋友死去。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ273894.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
